source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (night OR nighttime OR "after dark") AND (women OR safety OR mobility) AND (city OR street OR transport) NOT ("nighttime light" OR "night-time light")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(night OR nighttime OR "after dark") AND (women OR safety OR mobility) AND (city OR street OR transport) NOT ("nighttime light" OR "night-time light"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("after dark" OR "night" OR "nighttime") AND ("city" OR "street" OR "transport") AND ("mobility" OR "safety" OR "women") NOT ("night-time light" OR "nighttime light"))
